name: @muxos/plugin-installer-waits
description: How a `./muxos` command run as an install step reports a wait on another task, naming its holder from the op log: installGrantHooks (a host CPU grant wait — any CLI admission, a build's or a dependency install's under `./muxos start`), reportLockWait (a lock another run holds), and the stall rule that pauses the install when that holder stopped making progress.
